# Gold V1 — H4 data-quality gate

**Result: DATA QUALITY PASS**, 14 of 14 checks. The machine record is `data_quality.json`, regenerated by
`h4_study.py` on every run; the study aborts on any failure.

## Before computing H4

- **Earlier studies intact:** H1, H2, H3 and H5 were verified byte-identical to their closed state (SHA-256).
- **Existing tests pass:** 33/33 before any H4 code was written. Individually verified:
  - causal TVWAP: `test_tvwap_resets_causally`;
  - weighted σ precision: `test_tvwap_sigma_full_precision_near_4000`, which also shows the old formula fails;
  - session reset;
  - UTC/DST: `test_sessions_follow_dst`, `test_timestamps_parse_as_utc_and_boundary_holds` and the H5 opening-range DST
    test;
  - no future Asia-range leak: `test_asia_range_invisible_before_it_exists`, `test_asia_range_prefix_invariant`;
  - no previous-day leak: `test_previous_day_uses_completed_days_only`.
- **Unchanged:** the existing test files are unchanged, and no frozen Pine/P3.x/P2.x code was touched.

## Rerun corrected H1 gate (checks 1–12)

All 12 pass on the same development rows (10,355 M15 bars, 2025-12-23 00:00 → 2026-06-02 23:45 UTC). The evidence
is in `../h1/data_quality.md`.

## H4 additions

| check | result | method |
|---|---|---|
| h4_structure_causal | PASS | For every event: the whole exhaustion streak closed strictly outside the same side's 2σ, and the reentry closed strictly inside ±1σ 1–2 bars after the last outside close. Streak, reentry and entry are in one session. X is at least the 5th session bar. ER ≤ 0.15 at R, and R is not in the New York open hour. The stop is the extreme from the streak start to R. Entry = R + 1. |
| h4_prefix_invariance | PASS | Events recomputed on the first 70% of rows equal the full run inside the prefix: direction, X, R, stop, entry and target_R. |

## Regression tests

The new file is `research/gold_v1/tests/test_h4.py`, with 8 tests; the existing files are unchanged. The whole suite
runs:

```
venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider research/gold_v1/tests
```

It passes 41/41.

| test | what it pins |
|---|---|
| `test_race_uses_previous_bar_tvwap_not_the_current_one` | The live target during bar j is TVWAP[j−1]. A bar that touches its own (unknowable) TVWAP but not the previous one is not a hit. |
| `test_race_same_bar_target_and_stop_is_ambiguous_never_favourable` | AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR, counted as −1R in the economics |
| `test_race_gap_through_target_realizes_at_open_and_session_end_marks_to_market` | gap fills at the open; `session_end` is marked to market |
| `test_short_race_mirrors_long` | short-side race |
| `test_events_follow_every_band_rule` | every event meets items 2–9 and 16–18 on the real data, including that no bar between X and R re-exhausted the band |
| `test_one_event_per_streak` | item 10 |
| `test_ny_open_hour_is_dst_aware` | the 09:30–10:30 New York exclusion maps to 14:30–15:15 UTC in January and 13:30–14:15 UTC in May |
| `test_future_perturbation_does_not_change_past_events` | noise added to the second half of the sample leaves every earlier event unchanged |

## Data notes specific to H4

- **Session warm-up.** σ is 0 on each session's first bar and tiny for a few bars afterwards. The preregistered
  warm-up (X is at least the 5th bar) removes 207 of the 1,164 raw outside-2σ closes, which would otherwise be
  artifacts of a degenerate σ.
- **Live target.** The target is causal: at bar j the level is TVWAP at bar j−1's close. TVWAP resets at the session
  start, so the race stops at the session end (3 events ended that way).
